description:
Synthetic-generator stage for vector_search (docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md (revised 2026-11-26, PR #4540), decisions 1 and 6). Fixed-block per-table RNG (rand_chacha pinned, owned sampling, integer or pure-Rust libm math), delimited and Parquet output, and a per-benchmark generator version bump. Delimited value formatting matches the legacy generator's precision (no padded decimals or microseconds).

Decision gate: the acceptance report comparing legacy and new distributions and every query's row count across DuckDB and DataFusion needs owner approval before golden hashes are frozen.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
